method: Independent second layer per P51/C13. Every ICO in graphLinkedCompanies re-fetched directly from https://ares.gov.cz/ekonomicke-subjekty-v-be/rest/ekonomicke-subjekty-vr/<ICO> (accessed 2026-07-25) and parsed programmatically over the FULL clenoveOrganu array (current + historical entries), not read off the head of the list. Person identity confirmed by matching ARES datumNarozeni against the MP's psp.cz detail page. contractCzk sourcing spot-checked against hlidacstatu.cz. Systemic defect found: 5 of 10 army dossiers only inspected currently-registered officers and reported 'not present' for people who ARE present in the historical/complete organ record — the exact C11 false-clearance class.

verdicts.name: Jana Černochová
verdicts.findings: FALSE CLEARANCE ON ALL FOUR TIES — the most serious defect in this batch. The army asserted 've všech čtyřech případech nebyl ARES VR nalezen žádný osobní statutární vztah' and recommended flipping review_state from pending_review to CLEARED. My independent ARES VR pull finds Jana Černochová, nar. 1973-10-26 (exact match to her psp.cz detail page, 26. 10. 1973), as a registered officer in THREE of the four, plus a name+address match in the fourth. (1) SVJ Na Folimance 13 (26419050): člen statutárního orgánu, zapis 2000-12-15 → výmaz 2001-12-31. Army said she is not among the committee members. WRONG. (2) Nadační fond Českého rozhlasu (26419068, contractCzk 6 034 624,74): členka správní rady, vznikClenstvi 2006-06-01 → zanikClenstvi 2009-12-15 (registered 2008-05-12, deleted 2010-06-22); the entry carries no datumNarozeni but records her address as 'Na Folimance 2122/13, Vinohrady, 120 00 Praha 2' — i.e. the identical building as tie (1), which cross-confirms identity AND refutes the army's speculation that the SVJ is merely 'a building in her district, not her own residence'. Army said 'Černochová v orgánech NENÍ'. WRONG. (3) Obecní dům, a.s. (27251918): nar. 1973-10-26, členka dozorčí rady 2012-03-22 → 2013-06-14, then PŘEDSEDKYNĚ dozorčí rady, funkce 2013-05-27 → 2015-02-03 (výmaz 2015-02-23). Army said the supervisory board 'neobsahuje Černochovou'. WRONG — she chaired it. (4) Komwag, a.s. (61057606, contractCzk 7 399 794,70): nar. 1973-10-26, členka představenstva across four consecutive registrations — 2007-03-29→2011-03-08, funkce od 2012-05-25 (zapis 2012-07-09)→2015-09-29, 2015-09-29→2019-08-15, 2019-08-15→ zanikFunkce 2021-12-20 (výmaz 2022-01-29). Army said 'představenstvo i dozorčí rada uvádí jiná jména, Černochová v orgánech NENÍ'. WRONG — roughly 14 years on the board of a Prague municipal cleaning/maintenance company with 7.4M CZK in state contracts, ending only in December 2021. The army's error mode is uniform: it read only the currently-registered officers and reported absence.
verdicts.recommendedFix: Do NOT persist as written and do NOT clear these four ties. Replace effort_notes and the headline clause with the verified record: Černochová held registered statutory roles in three of the four entities (Komwag představenstvo cca 2007–12/2021; Obecní dům dozorčí rada 2012–2015, from 5/2013 as chair; Nadační fond ČRo správní rada 2006–2009; SVJ Na Folimance statutární orgán 2000–2001). All four remain pending_review — the recommendation to clear must be struck. Frame conservatively: these are municipal/public Prague entities and the roles are consistent with her long-running Prague 2 municipal mandate, i.e. offices held ex officio as a city politician, NOT evidence of wrongdoing; all ended before the PSP10 mandate (most recent: Komwag, 12/2021). Per public-role-facts-only, state the SVJ statutory role as a register fact and drop any statement about where she lives — do not publish the Na Folimance address.

verdicts.name: Helena Langšádlová
verdicts.findings: Independently re-fetched ARES VR for Fórum Karla Schwarzenberga, o.p.s. (02086778, record aktualizace 2025-11-05, stav AKTIVNI). HELENA LANGŠÁDLOVÁ, nar. 1963-10-14, is in ostatniOrgany / Správní rada, zapis 2013-09-10, NO datumVymazu — an ACTIVE, currently registered role, exactly as the army claimed. contractCzk 0 matches graphLinkedCompanies. This is the one dossier in the batch whose money finding was a live current officer role and the army got it right and did not under-claim it. No omission: graphLinkedCompanies has exactly one entry and the prose covers it. The prose is appropriately conservative (transparent political-institutional role, zero contract value, explicitly not framed as a conflict of interest). Optional enrichment, not a defect: the register shows the membership running since 2013-09-10, i.e. 12+ years, which the write-up does not date.

verdicts.name: Jana Patková
verdicts.findings: Independently re-fetched ARES VR for Hvězdárna a planetárium v Hradci Králové (00084018). The record contains exactly two persons across all organs, ever: Ing. František Hovorka (2003-08-05 → 2014-06-28) and Mgr. MIROSLAV KREJČÍ (2014-06-28 → 2015-10-26, re-registered 2015-10-26, no výmaz = current). No Patková in any organ, current or historical — the army's verified-absence claim survives a complete-record check, which is the correct basis for a negative under the C11 rule (VR endpoint, not the plain endpoint). Only company in graphLinkedCompanies, covered in the prose; contractCzk 648 907,98 quoted correctly and correctly characterised as institutional (příspěvková organizace of the Královéhradecký kraj), not personal. Nit, not a defect: the army dates Krejčí's directorship from 1. 3. 2014; the register's zapis is 2014-06-28.

verdicts.name: Ivana Mádlová
verdicts.findings: Both ties independently re-verified and both are genuine and correctly identified — PhDr. IVANA MÁDLOVÁ, nar. 1966-03-31, appears in both records. No omissions; both companies in graphLinkedCompanies are covered and the contract figures match. Two defects, both minor. (a) DATE CONFLATION at VODÁRNA PLZEŇ a.s. (25205625): the register shows členka dozorčí rady 2016-01-18 → 2016-03-02, then MÍSTOPŘEDSEDKYNĚ dozorčí rady with vznikFunkce 2016-02-08 and zanikFunkce 2018-12-31, deleted from the register 2019-02-23. The army writes 'členství skončilo 23. 2. 2019', which reports the registry-deletion date as the end of the membership — the function actually ended 2018-12-31. This is the same undated/conflated-date class Opus caught in batch 002. (b) ORGAN MISLABEL in the headline: DOMOVINKA - sociální služby, o.p.s. (29123747) — the register places her in the SPRÁVNÍ rada (2012-01-16 → 2014-09-22, matching the army's notes), not a supervisory board, yet the headline generalises both ties as 'dvě ... dozorčí role'. The substantive conclusion — both roles historical, ended years before the PSP10 mandate, institutional rather than personal — is correct and holds.
verdicts.recommendedFix: In effort_notes, change the Vodárna Plzeň sentence to 'funkce místopředsedkyně dozorčí rady 8. 2. 2016 – 31. 12. 2018, výmaz z obchodního rejstříku 23. 2. 2019'. In the headline, replace 'dvě ... dozorčí role' with 'dvě ... role v orgánech (dozorčí rada Vodárny Plzeň, správní rada DOMOVINKY)'.

verdicts.name: Robert Stržínek
verdicts.findings: TWO ACTIVE CURRENT STATUTORY ROLES REPORTED AS UNRESOLVED / HISTORICAL. Identity confirmed: ROBERT STRŽÍNEK, nar. 1968-11-23, exact match to psp.cz (23. 11. 1968). (1) Vodovody a kanalizace Vsetín, a.s. (47674652) — the army wrote that its ARES VR query 'NEOBSAHOVAL sekci se statutárními orgány vůbec' and left the case NEDOŘEŠENÝ. That is factually wrong: the record (480 KB, aktualizace 2025-12-23, stav AKTIVNI) DOES contain statutarniOrgany with 75 member entries, almost certainly truncated in the army's fetch. Stržínek appears four times: PŘEDSEDA PŘEDSTAVENSTVA 2015-06-04 → 2019-06-04; PŘEDSEDA PŘEDSTAVENSTVA 2019-06-06 → 2023-06-06; and MÍSTOPŘEDSEDA PŘEDSTAVENSTVA, vznikFunkce 2023-06-08, zapis 2023-07-20, WITH NO zanikFunkce AND NO datumVymazu — an ACTIVE role as of the register's last update. He has therefore led the board of this water utility (745 152,49 CZK in state contracts) continuously since June 2015 and still sits on it as vice-chair, CONCURRENTLY with his PSP10 mandate (from ~October 2025). This is a live current tie, not an unresolved one. (2) Tenisový klub DEZA Valašské Meziříčí, z.s. (47997826, contractCzk 6 221 902) — the army called this 'historická role ... skončilo cca 4,5 roku před mandátem PSP10'. The register shows TWO entries: člen správní rady vznikClenstvi 2016-01-28 → zanikClenstvi 2021-01-28 (deleted 2021-03-10), AND a second entry with vznikClenstvi 2021-01-28, NO zanikClenstvi and NO výmaz — also ACTIVE (record aktualizace 2024-08-10). He was re-elected, not removed. The army's dates (25. 4. 2016 – 25. 4. 2021) do not match the register either. (3) OVER-CLAIM at Nemocnice AGEL Valašské Meziříčí a.s. (26822105): the army states he 'byl členem představenstva 1. 3. 2020 – 30. 9. 2022'. I enumerated all 45 představenstvo entries in the record and Stržínek is in NONE of them; his AGEL involvement is dozorčí rada only, across three registrations 2015-08-18 → 2023-02-22. So this dossier both under-claims two live ties and over-claims one board seat that does not exist in VR.
verdicts.recommendedFix: Rewrite the money block and the headline. VaK Vsetín: 'předseda představenstva 4. 6. 2015 – 6. 6. 2023, od 8. 6. 2023 místopředseda představenstva — role AKTIVNÍ, souběžná s poslaneckým mandátem (ARES VR, stav k 23. 12. 2025)'. Tenisový klub DEZA: 'člen správní rady od 28. 1. 2016, znovuzvolen 28. 1. 2021, role AKTIVNÍ (ARES VR, stav k 10. 8. 2024)'. AGEL: delete the představenstvo sentence entirely and keep only 'člen dozorčí rady 2015–2023' — VR records no board membership. The headline claim that his ties are 'většinou historické' and that VaK Vsetín 'zůstává nedořešená' must be replaced: two of the three ties are CURRENT. Keep the army's genuinely good contextual framing (these are offices held ex officio as mayor of Valašské Meziříčí, disclosed in public registers — a triple-mandate transparency finding, not an allegation of wrongdoing), but the ties must be recorded as active, and all three stay pending_review.

verdicts.name: Miloslav Janulík
verdicts.findings: A FALSE NEGATIVE ON THE HIGHEST-VALUE COMPANY, PLUS A ~19-YEAR DATE ERROR AND A MISIDENTIFIED BUSINESS. Identity confirmed: MUDr. Miloslav Janulík, nar. 1962-09-21, exact match to psp.cz (21. 9. 1962). (1) Nemocnice Valtice s.r.o. (63488329, contractCzk 18 538 621,4 — the largest of his three): the army wrote 'current i dostupní historičtí jednatelé ... NEZAHRNUJÍ Janulíka — žádná osobní statutární vazba v dostupných VR datech nalezena'. WRONG. The record contains MUDr. Miloslav Janulík, nar. 1962-09-21, as JEDNATEL, zapis 1998-02-12 → výmaz 1999-05-18. Same head-of-list reading error as elsewhere in this batch. (2) DATE ERROR: the army asserts his directorships at both polyclinic entities 'skončila před přeregistrací současných jednatelů ... k 2018-05-03/04', and the headline says 'historickou (do 2018) jednatelskou vazbou'. Both are wrong by roughly two decades. At Poliklinika Břeclav, s.r.o. (46978593) he was jednatel 1992-12-01 → výmaz 1999-05-06. The 2018-05-03 date the army read as an officer change is in fact only a NAME-FORMAT re-registration in obchodniJmeno (spaced-out lettering normalised to 'Poliklinika Břeclav, s. r. o.'), not a change of jednatel. (3) MISSED OWNERSHIP FACT: at Poliklinika Břeclav he was also SPOLEČNÍK (owner) 1995-08-23 → 1999-05-06 — a stronger fact than the directorship the army did report, and omitted entirely. (4) MISIDENTIFIED ENTITY: IČO 49437674 is listed in the graph as 'POLIKLINIKA - servis s.r.o.' and the army describes it as one of 'obě zdravotnická zařízení, kde dříve sám působil jako ředitel'. The obchodniJmeno history shows the company was 'Týdeník Moravský Jih, s.r.o.' from 1993-08-25 and was only RENAMED to 'POLIKLINIKA - servis s.r.o.' on 2002-08-28. Janulík was its jednatel 1993-08-25 with zanikFunkce 2002-02-14 (výmaz 2002-08-28) — i.e. he was a director of a regional WEEKLY NEWSPAPER publisher and left it at the very moment it was renamed. Calling this a healthcare-facility tie is a category error.
verdicts.recommendedFix: Do not persist as written. Correct effort_notes to: Poliklinika Břeclav, s.r.o. (46978593) — jednatel 1. 12. 1992 – 6. 5. 1999 AND společník 23. 8. 1995 – 6. 5. 1999; IČO 49437674 — jednatel 25. 8. 1993 – 14. 2. 2002 of the company then named 'Týdeník Moravský Jih, s.r.o.', renamed 'POLIKLINIKA - servis s.r.o.' only on 28. 8. 2002, after his departure (describe it as a media/publishing tie, not a healthcare one); Nemocnice Valtice s.r.o. (63488329) — jednatel 12. 2. 1998 – 18. 5. 1999, so the 'no personal tie found' sentence must be struck and replaced with a confirmed historical directorship. Remove '(do 2018)' from the headline and replace with '(vše ukončeno 1999–2002)'. All three ties are genuinely historical, ~24–27 years before the PSP10 mandate — the corrected story is actually a cleaner one for him than the army's, and should be stated without any implication of current entanglement.

verdicts.name: Jiří Pospíšil
verdicts.findings: The strongest of the ten dossiers and its central finding is CORRECT and independently confirmed. Identity: JUDr. Jiří Pospíšil, nar. 1975-11-24, in all five records. All five companies in graphLinkedCompanies are covered and all five contractCzk figures quoted in the prose (8,6M / 7,8M / 4,2M / 0,51M / 88,1M) reconcile exactly to the graph values. Confirmed: at Museum Kampa (49370499, registry name now 'Česká nadace Jana a Medy Mládkových') he was PŘEDSEDA SPRÁVNÍ RADY vznikFunkce 2016-06-03 → zanikFunkce 2023-05-27 (výmaz 2023-07-13) — the army's headline claim that the still-circulating TOP09/media label 'dlouholetý předseda Museum Kampa' is stale since May 2023 is exactly right, and is a genuine primary-source-beats-media catch. Confirmed: the only currently active tie is Muzeum paměti XX. století, z.ú. (08694508), člen dozorčí rady, re-registered 2024-12-30 with no výmaz. Confirmed historical: Nadace Charty 77 (00417904) 2015-10-30 → zanikFunkce 2018-07-15; RRA Plzeňského kraje (25245091) 2003-11-27 → 2009-04-16; Nadace Janouškových (27149994) předseda 2004-05-12 → 2005-07-08, předseda 2016-05-27 → 2018-03-09, člen → 2021-10-06. Three imprecisions: (a) the HEADLINE says the four closed ties are 'uzavřené kapitoly z let 2003–2021', but Museum Kampa ran to May 2023 — the headline contradicts its own notes; (b) the army dates his Museum Kampa involvement 'od června 2016', omitting that he was already ČLEN SPRÁVNÍ RADY from 2011-11-24, so the real span is 2011–2023 (~12 years), an under-claim; (c) Nadace Charty 77 is described as two stints ('2015–2017 a únor–srpen 2018') when the register shows one continuous membership 2015-10-30 → 2018-07-15 re-registered three times. The prose is otherwise commendably conservative — it correctly states the contractCzk sums are the nonprofits' own public contracts, not personal income.
verdicts.recommendedFix: Headline: change 'uzavřené kapitoly z let 2003–2021' to 'uzavřené kapitoly z let 2003–2023'. effort_notes: change the Museum Kampa entry to 'člen správní rady od 24. 11. 2011, předseda správní rady 3. 6. 2016 – 27. 5. 2023' and the Charty 77 entry to a single continuous membership '30. 10. 2015 – 15. 7. 2018 (výmaz 22. 8. 2018)'.

verdicts.name: Andrea Hoffmannová
verdicts.findings: Independently re-fetched https://ares.gov.cz/ekonomicke-subjekty-v-be/rest/ekonomicke-subjekty-vr/61989592 — HTTP 404, reproducing the army's result exactly. The army's interpretation is correct and is the right kind of reasoning: a 404 here is the EXPECTED response because Univerzita Palackého is a public university established by statute (právní forma 601) and is not entered in the obchodní rejstřík at all, so absence of a VR record characterises the entity type rather than constituting an unverified negative. It correctly did not treat the 404 as a clearance and correctly declined to attribute the 224 319 743,1 CZK institutional figure to Hoffmannová personally, instead recommending Case ① confirm in Registr smluv whether any underlying contract names her before the item leaves pending_review — precisely the conservative posture the doctrine asks for. Only one company in graphLinkedCompanies, covered. No over-claim, no under-claim, no omission. The single-source ancestry of the positive claim (Hlídač státu shows only the Ph.D. relationship) is acknowledged as such in the prose.

verdicts.name: Lenka Martínková Španihelová
verdicts.findings: AMBIGUITY RESOLVED — AND THE ARMY'S PRIMARY-SOURCE NEGATIVE IS FALSE. The army reported that ARES VR 'Španihelová v primárním rejstříku VR NENÍ uvedena mezi statutárními orgány', flagged this as a ROZPOR with the secondary sources describing her as MATURUS's founding director, and asked Case ① to resolve it via or.justice.cz. My independent pull of the full clenoveOrganu array for MATURUS, o.p.s. (24766216, aktualizace 2026-07-22) finds her plainly there: statutarniOrgany / Statutární orgán — 'Lenka Španihelová', nar. 1984-04-19, zapis 2011-06-29, výmaz 2014-10-07, listed immediately before JITKA ČECHOVÁ (ředitel 2014-09-04 → 2026-06-30) and MAGDALÉNA LINDAUROVÁ (ředitel from 2026-07-01). IDENTITY CONFIRMED: her psp.cz detail page (id 7023) gives her date of birth as 19. 4. 1984, an exact match. The register entry carries her then-address at Malá Bystřice, okres Vsetín — she was a Zlín-region resident at the time and only later became a Pardubice-region councillor, which is why the surname/region heuristic looked contradictory. The primary registry therefore CORROBORATES the secondary sources rather than contradicting them: she was the statutory organ (director) of MATURUS from mid-2011 until October 2014, succeeded by Čechová. The army's error is the same head-of-list reading fault seen elsewhere in this batch — it inspected only the two most recent director entries. No omission otherwise (one company, covered); contractCzk 1 197 779 is characterised correctly as public/subsidy funding of a social enterprise, not commercial profit, and the entity description (employer of people with disabilities, MPSV as main counterparty) is conservative and appropriate.
verdicts.recommendedFix: Replace the whole contradiction paragraph with a resolved, primary-sourced statement: 'MATURUS, o.p.s. (IČO 24766216) — Španihelová (tehdy Lenka Španihelová, nar. 19. 4. 1984) byla statutárním orgánem (ředitelkou) sociálního podniku, zápis 29. 6. 2011, výmaz 7. 10. 2014; nástupkyní byla Jitka Čechová (4. 9. 2014 – 30. 6. 2026), od 1. 7. 2026 Magdaléna Lindaurová. Ověřeno přímo v ARES VR; sekundární zdroje (Wikipedie, Hlídač státu) popisující ji jako zakládající ředitelku jsou tím potvrzeny, nikoli v rozporu.' Delete the recommendation that Case ① chase the sbírka listin — the question is answered. Update the headline: the tie is a CONFIRMED historical directorship (2011–2014, ~11 years before the PSP10 mandate), not an unverified secondary-source lead. The item can be described as a resolved historical role, though the review_state flip itself remains the human gate's call.

verdicts.name: Aleš Juchelka
verdicts.findings: THE HEADLINE MONEY FINDING IS FULLY CONFIRMED, INDEPENDENTLY AND TO THE DAY. OCCAM PR s.r.o. (27840531, aktualizace 2026-01-21): Ing. ALEŠ JUCHELKA, nar. 1976-04-18, JEDNATEL with vznikFunkce 2008-03-31 and zanikFunkce 2026-01-08 (výmaz 2026-01-16), and simultaneously SPOLEČNÍK holding a 200 000 CZK vklad = 100 % podíl from 2008-03-31 until 2026-01-16. Ing. TEREZA JUCHELKOVÁ, nar. 1976-10-02, became jednatel with vznikFunkce 2026-01-09 and 100 % společník registered 2026-01-16. The army's '8.–16. 1. 2026' transfer window is exactly right. He therefore held sole directorship and 100 % ownership of the company through the entire PSP10 mandate to date AND through the first three-and-a-half weeks of his tenure as Minister of Labour and Social Affairs (from 15. 12. 2025). The contract figure is independently confirmed: hlidacstatu.cz/subjekt/27840531 reports 2 contracts in the registr smluv totalling 177 870 CZK, reconciling exactly to graphLinkedCompanies contractCzk 177 870. YOU STORY UP! s.r.o. (02751232) also confirmed to the day: jednatel vznikFunkce 2014-03-10 → zanikFunkce 2016-08-11 (výmaz 2016-08-18), společník 2014-03-10 → 2016-08-18 — matching the army's dates precisely, and its flagged discrepancy (contractCzk 6 271 561,8 with no corresponding registr smluv record in his tenure) is a legitimate, well-framed data-provenance question for Case ①, not an over-claim. ARES VR for ČESKÁ TELEVIZE (00027383) and ČESKÝ ROZHLAS (45245053) both returned HTTP 404 as I re-checked — expected for statutory public broadcasters, correctly interpreted. All four companies covered, no omission. The single defect is a doctrine issue, not a factual one: the write-up names Tereza Juchelková as 'manželka'. The commercial register establishes only her name, birth date and the transfer; it does not record the relationship, and she is not herself a public official, so under 'public-role facts only' the relational label needs either an explicit public source or neutral phrasing. The transfer itself is squarely a public-interest fact and should be kept.
verdicts.recommendedFix: In effort_notes and the headline, either cite a named public source for the spousal relationship or use register-neutral phrasing: 'vlastnictví převedl 8.–16. 1. 2026 na Ing. Terezu Juchelkovou'. Everything else in the money block stands as written and is safe to persist; optionally tighten to the register's exact dates (funkce jednatele skončila 8. 1. 2026, převod podílu zapsán 16. 1. 2026, nová jednatelka od 9. 1. 2026).
